description: A special instruction in modern LLM systems that defines the model's role, behavioral rules, and safety guidelines — before the user enters their own prompt. The system prompt is usually invisible to the user, but fundamentally controls the model's baseline behavior.
example: An AI chatbot receives a system prompt such as: 'You are a helpful assistant. Respond precisely and politely.' Other assistants likewise receive a system prompt at runtime that defines their role and behavioral rules. Users don't see these instructions, but they determine how the model responds.
